text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so the panel's composition can't explain why he was chosen over you. An all-male panel is common in senior finance roles and says more about the sector's pipeline than about this decision. Raising it would weaken your credibility and distract from your actual grievance.

Your real issue is substantive: on paper you appear better qualified (PhD vs. master's, nine years in the specific discipline), and they haven't answered your request for written reasons within a reasonable period. That silence is the stronger point.

Send a firm follow-up citing your original request and date, ask for the scoring criteria, panel notes and how "broad regulatory experience" was weighted, and set a deadline before escalating internally.
